description:
Search software products on Capterra by name or keyword; returns the product ids the
        other Capterra tools take.

        Cost: 1 credit per call (also when nothing matches).

        Args:
            query: Product name or keyword.
            limit: Results to return, 1-10 (default 10).
            cursor: `next_cursor` from a previous call for more results (1 credit).
name: capterra_search_products
title: Search Capterra products
